how_to_query:
# 1. Discover the ATS (the Lever and Greenhouse hints BOTH 404 -- Quantiphi is on Workday):
curl -s "https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/quantiphi?mode=json"        # -> {"ok":false,"error":"Document not found"}
curl -s "https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/quantiphi/jobs"   # -> {"status":404,"error":"Job not found"}
curl -sL "https://quantiphi.com/careers/" | grep -oiE "myworkdayjobs\.com[^\"' ]*"
# -> myworkdayjobs.com/Careers_at_Quantiphi   (tenant=quantiphi, host=wd1, site=Careers_at_Quantiphi)

# 2. LIST all postings (110 total; paginate offset 0,20,40,60,80,100):
curl -s -X POST "https://quantiphi.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/quantiphi/Careers_at_Quantiphi/jobs" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json" -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" \
  -d '{"appliedFacets":{},"limit":20,"offset":0,"searchText":""}'
# Each jobPostings[] entry gives: title, locationsText, externalPath, postedOn

# 3. FULL description + verbatim qualifications for one job (append externalPath verbatim):
curl -s "https://quantiphi.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/quantiphi/Careers_at_Quantiphi/job/IN-MH-Mumbai-Eureka/Senior-Business-Analyst_JR10303" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0"
# Read .jobPostingInfo.jobDescription (HTML), .location, .additionalLocations, .startDate, .endDate, .externalUrl

# 4. Keyword search (works; "graduate"/"campus"/"fresher" all return total:0):
curl -s -X POST ".../Careers_at_Quantiphi/jobs" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"appliedFacets":{},"limit":20,"offset":0,"searchText":"intern"}'

# 5. Facet counts (Job Category / Job Type / Location) come back in the LIST response under .facets
#    NOTE: re-POSTing those facet ids under appliedFacets.locationMainGroup returns HTTP_400 --
#    filtering by location via the API does not work; I counted India/Mumbai by fetching
#    .location + .additionalLocations for all 58 candidate postings instead.

# Human-browsable board: https://quantiphi.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/Careers_at_Quantiphi
student_programs:
NO internship, graduate, campus or analyst programme exists for India on Quantiphi's careers portal right now. This is a verified negative, not a gap in my search:

1. The Workday "Job Type" (workerSubType) facet across all 110 live postings returns exactly: FTE = 108, Intern (Fixed Term) (Trainee) = 1, Contractor = 1. Applying the intern facet id (004c6095ba3b1000b2cd563c68280001) returns total:1 -- and that single global intern req is "Intern - IT & Facilities Support", US MA Boston, JR10760 (https://quantiphi.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/Careers_at_Quantiphi/job/US-MA-Boston/Intern---IT---Facilities-Support_JR10760). It is a US facilities role, not relevant, and not in India.
2. searchText="graduate" -> total 0. searchText="campus" -> total 0. searchText="fresher" -> total 0. (searchText="intern" returns 32 hits but these are fuzzy full-text matches on words like "internal"/"international", not intern roles.)
3. Zero of the 50 India postings is an internship, trainee, graduate-programme or campus req. Every India posting is a full-time experienced hire.

STATUS: no India student programme is OPEN. Nothing is listed as CLOSED either -- the portal simply carries none.

THE ONE OPEN DOOR FOR A STUDENT -- "Resume Dropbox", JR467:
https://quantiphi.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/Careers_at_Quantiphi/job/IN-MH-Mumbai-Eureka/Resume-Dropbox_JR467
Locations: IN MH Mumbai Eureka + IN KA Bengaluru + IN KL Trivandrum + Canada Remote + USA Remote. Posted 2023-04-12, still live, no end date. Full verbatim text: "If \"No Matching Jobs\" are found, please submit your resume/ cover letter in word or PDF format so that the Talent team of Quantiphi will review and take necessary action." This is an always-open general-application pipeline with NO stated qualification bar, NO years requirement and Mumbai as its primary location. It is the only Quantiphi entry point that a May-2027 graduand can submit to without misrepresenting experience. It is also, by construction, a pure black hole without a referral -- it dumps into a talent-team queue with no req attached. Submitting to JR467 AND having an employee ping the Mumbai talent team with the submission is the realistic play.

REFERRAL LEVERAGE IS UNUSUALLY HIGH HERE, for a structural reason visible in the data: Quantiphi's own JD for Engagement Manager (JR11266) lists as a core responsibility "Work closely with talent acquisition and resource management teams to identify, vet, and onboard suitable candidates (BAs, Senior BAs, Developers, Architects etc.) for project roles across Geographies". Delivery-side managers at Quantiphi are explicitly chartered to source and vet candidates themselves. A referral from a Mumbai Engagement Manager or Senior BA therefore routes around the portal rather than merely flagging a portal application.

WHAT I CANNOT VERIFY: whether Quantiphi runs India campus hiring off-portal through college placement cells (which would be the normal route for a DJSCE final-year student, and would not appear on this Workday board at all). Nothing on the portal or the careers page confirms or denies an off-portal campus track. That must be checked through the DJSCE TPO, not through this feed.
limitations:
WHAT I GOT: full, complete, verbatim data. The Workday CXS API was fully reachable via curl. I paginated all 110 live postings and fetched the complete jobDescription HTML for 29 India roles plus location data for all 58 India-relevant postings. Counts are exact, not estimates: 110 postings live; 50 have at least one India location; 44 include Mumbai (Eureka/Quantum/ISD); 36 include Bengaluru; 12 include Trivandrum.

WHAT I COULD NOT GET, explicitly:
1. NO salary or compensation data anywhere. Quantiphi's Workday tenant exposes no pay range field for any posting, India or US.
2. NO requisition ID field. jobPostingInfo.jobRequisitionId is null on every single posting. The "JR#####" strings I report are parsed out of the externalPath URL slug, which is reliable but is not an API-provided field.
3. NO application deadlines except one. jobPostingInfo.endDate is null on 109 of 110 postings. The sole exception is System Specialist - Workday (JR11781), endDate 2026-10-30. Every other role is open-ended, which means some are almost certainly stale -- "Resume Dropbox" has been live since 2023-04-12 and several India reqs carry startDates from Jan-Apr 2026, i.e. five to eight months old.
4. Location filtering via the API is BROKEN. Re-POSTing the location facet ids under appliedFacets.locationMainGroup returns HTTP_400 with an empty message. I worked around this by fetching .location and .additionalLocations for every candidate posting individually, so the counts above are still exact -- but anyone reproducing this cannot simply filter by location server-side.
5. NO applicant-count, no recruiter name, no hiring-manager info, no interview-process detail is exposed by this endpoint.
6. I could not verify off-portal campus/placement-cell hiring. See student_programs.

THE HARD TRUTH ABOUT THIS BOARD, stated plainly rather than papered over: Quantiphi's India hiring is almost entirely a mid-to-senior experienced-hire board and it is a poor fit for a May-2027 graduand as posted. Of 50 India postings, exactly ONE (PMO Analyst, JR11629, "1 to 3 Years") has a stated lower bound under 2 years, and its own must-have bullet still demands "1-2 years of experience in a coordination, administrative, or project support role within a professional services or project-driven environment". One more (System Specialist - Workday, JR11781) asks "2+ years of experience with Workday in an administrative role" -- a tool the candidate has never used. Every remaining India role starts at 3+ years minimum, and the median is 4-7. There is no Quantiphi India req that a candidate with zero full-time corporate experience qualifies for on the written bar.

TWO GENUINE INTERNAL CONTRADICTIONS I found and preserved verbatim, because they widen the apparent bar and matter downstream:
- Senior Business Analyst (JR10303, Mumbai) headers "Experience Level: 4-7 Years" but its actual requirements bullet says only "3+ years of experience in decision support, business analysis, business consulting or project management". The requirement block is one full year softer than the header.
- Senior Data Engineer - BI developer (JR10405-1, Mumbai) headers "Exp : 3 -6 Years" but its requirements bullet demands "6+ years of experience as a Looker Developer or in a BI/analytics development role". Here the header is FOUR years softer than the real bar -- do not trust the header on this one.

A THIRD, SOFTER ONE worth flagging: Associate Client Solutions Partner (JR11268, Mumbai) headers "Years of Experience: 6 to 8" but its first skills bullet reads "Demonstrable experience in Presales/Deal Solutioning roles with a minimum of 2+ years of experience in the Data/Analytics and AI specializing in Insurance". The 2+ figure is the only number in the requirements block.

I have fabricated nothing. Every job, job ID, URL, date and qualification line below was read directly out of the live Workday API response on 2026-09-24. Qualification text is copied verbatim including its original typos ("quantifi able", "identifi cation", "Handover experience", "data piplines") and its original bullet ordering.

roles.title: PMO Analyst
roles.location: IN KA Bengaluru (JD text states "Location - Bangalore/Mumbai")
roles.basic_qualifications:
Job Role - PMO Analyst
Location - Bangalore/Mumbai
Experience - 1 to 3 Years

Must Have Skills & Experience:
- 1-2 years of experience in a coordination, administrative, or project support role within a professional services or project-driven environment.
- Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate clearly and concisely with diverse stakeholders.
- Proficiency in Google Suite (Sheets, Doc, PowerPoint).
- Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Proactive and problem-solving mindset.
- Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Tools Used : Google Sheets, Google Looker Studio, Google Docs, Google Slides, Workday
roles.preferred_qualifications:
Good to Have Skills & Experience:
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Project Management, or a related field.
- Looker Dashboard Management: Utilize and maintain Looker dashboards to visualize resource data, identify trends, and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
- Proficiency in using and creating dashboards within Looker.
- Basic understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall).
- Familiarity with HR processes and policies.
- Familiarity with WorkDay - Processes, Reports
- A genuine interest in optimizing team performance and efficiency.
roles.description_gist: LOWEST EXPERIENCE BAR OF ALL 50 INDIA REQS and the single most realistic named opening on this board. Resource allocation, utilisation reporting, staffing-gap flagging, dashboard maintenance -- this is product/resource operations, squarely in the candidate's stated target. The entire must-have tooling list is Google Sheets/Docs/Slides; no SQL, no Python, no Java, no C++ demanded. Two gaps, both closable in weeks: Google Looker Studio (free, genuinely learnable in 2-3 weeks, and it is named in BOTH the Tools Used list and the good-to-have block) and basic Workday reporting familiarity. The candidate's funnel-analysis, EDA and PowerBI work transfers directly to the Looker Studio ask. Note the JD says Bangalore/Mumbai even though the Workday location tag is Bengaluru only -- worth asking about Mumbai base.

roles.preferred_qualifications: No separate preferred section. "(must have)" is attached inline to the technical-sales/cloud-data-AI bullet.
roles.description_gist: MUMBAI-PRIMARY AND THE MOST CONSULTING-SHAPED ROLE ON THE INDIA BOARD. The JD asks for drafting client proposals and RFP responses, financial proposals and customer business cases, deal reviews, pipeline and funnel maintenance, quarterly growth targets -- which is very close to what he actually did at Infiheal (Series A investor materials end-to-end, fundraise narrative, IndiGo and HDFC Bank enterprise B2B pipeline from first contact to proposal). The header/requirement contradiction is material: the header says 6-8 years but the skills block's only number is "a minimum of 2+ years". Genuine blockers: P&C insurance/broker domain and regulatory landscape, "Direct experience selling to clients in the US and India", and enterprise CRM systems -- he has no Salesforce/CRM exposure. A free Salesforce Trailhead path (1-2 weeks) plus reading into P&C insurance business models would address two of the softer bullets. Flag honestly: this is a presales/GTM role, which is adjacent to but not identical to the analytics/BI target -- include it only if he is open to strategy/presales consulting.

roles.description_gist: THE ONLY INDIA POSTING WITH A HARD DEADLINE: endDate 2026-10-30. It is also the freshest req on the entire board (posted 2026-09-23) and is 100% Mumbai across all three offices. Second-lowest years bar in India at 2+. Responsibilities are analyst-flavoured -- "Generate standard and custom reports and dashboards", stakeholder requirement gathering, calculated fields, business process configuration. BUT the gate is unambiguous and unfakeable: "2+ years of experience with Workday in an administrative role" plus HCM process and security knowledge. Workday is an enterprise HR platform with no free tier and no meaningful self-study path; Workday certification is partner-gated, not open enrolment. This is NOT learnable in 2-6 weeks. Listed because it is the newest, deadline-bearing, all-Mumbai role -- but honestly assessed, it is closed to him.
